name: platform: the governance apparatus governs itself
note: Reflexive self-governance — the apparatus priced under its OWN model. warn = the apparatus's integrity controls OFF (an unsigned/unbounded feed poisons the £, the AI proposer auto-merges a bad policy, Flux silently heals to a bad state); deny = the same three self-controls ON (signed+sourced+bounded feeds, bounded proposer, the PR gate as hard backstop). LM is large because the apparatus governs the WHOLE estate: a compromise mis-prices or mis-enforces everywhere, not in one workload. Triples are (min,mode,max); £/GBP, events per year. Scored by ../risk/enforce.py against ../risk/appetite.json (org 'platform', marked root_of_trust) — the same maths, and the same store, that judges driftwood/tuppence/ludlow, turned on itself.
